cases.title: M200 PPO Medical with Other Payer, Pay, Reverse, Read
cases.rationale: Tests adjudication of a medical claim for M200 on 2026-07-02 under commercial_ppo. Applies other payer payment (12345) before deductible. Calculates remaining balance against individual deductible (10000) and copay (1500). Verifies finance pay, reverse (adding credit ledger), and readback of restored state.

provenance.requirement: Create one new four-step case for customer M200 using commercial_ppo on 2026-07-02: submit a medical line for 97321 cents with 12345 cents already paid by another payer; finance pays; finance reverses; the owner reads back. Assert all required quote, net ledger, history and restored account observations. Use valid unique operation keys and at least three characters in every claim/line ID.
